explication: React Virtualized is a React component library for rendering large scrollable collections efficiently. A consumer imports a component, supplies data and layout/rendering props, and receives a virtualized view; the central Grid capability supports the list and tabular-data use cases. The public exports and component families are evidenced by source/index.js and the tree. Internal wiring among most components was not sampled, so the graph avoids asserting those call relationships.
